description:
OT Over + Reg Under -> works, double win possible
OT Under + Reg Over -> double loss possible, if end of reg. time under wins, but with the 1 additional goal scored during OT / Pen, over suddenly wins.

cases.description: $A settles Over on the score after overtime and the shootout, $B settles Under on regular time. The extra goal can only ever push the Over in, so the two legs can both win and can never both lose.

$A settles Under on the score after overtime and the shootout, $B settles Over on regular time. A game that is under the line at the end of regulation and then goes to overtime gains a goal: $B's Over has already lost on regular time, and the extra goal makes $A's Under lose too - both legs lose.
